title: Cornering stability and body roll
summary: Feedback in this topic centers on how the G70 behaves in corners, with one clearly positive comment but most fragments too ambiguous in sentiment to separate praise about handling from concerns about shakiness or roll.

positive.summary: One positive review praises confident high-speed cornering and enjoyable handling.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mix favorable cornering remarks with mentions of shakiness, excess body roll, and abnormal noise, so the overall stance cannot be resolved from the examples alone.

limitations: Most examples are labeled undetermined, which limits confidence in summarizing sentiment beyond the single positive review.
The topic cluster mixes cornering performance, shakiness, body roll, and abnormal noise, which may reflect more than one underlying issue.
